stemMd: A line segment is perpendicular to a projection plane. What does its orthographic projection onto that plane look like?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A segment twice its true length

options.label: B
options.textMd: A segment of its true length

explanationMd: Every point on a segment perpendicular to the plane lies along the same projection ray. All therefore map to one foot point. The projected length is zero.

distractorRationale.b: True length requires the segment to be parallel to the plane.
distractorRationale.d: Projection of a straight segment cannot create a circle.
distractorRationale.a: Orthographic projection cannot enlarge this segment.
distractorRationale.c: Parallel projection preserves straightness or collapses the line.
